tasks.title: Set up project structure and navigation framework
tasks.description: Create the foundational app structure with routing capability to switch between calculator and settings screens. Set up shared styles and design tokens from the mockups.
acceptanceCriteria: App loads and displays the calculator screen on first launch
User can navigate between screens without errors

tasks.title: Build Calculator Screen UI
tasks.description: Implement the complete visual layout of the calculator screen including header, bill amount input, tip percentage buttons, and results display section.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen displays 'Tip Calculator' as the header
User sees a large input field for entering the bill amount
User sees six tip percentage buttons arranged in a 3x2 grid (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 22%, 25%)
User sees a results section showing 'Tip Amount' and 'Total' labels with placeholder values
Settings icon appears in the top-right corner of the header

tasks.title: Implement tip calculation logic
tasks.description: Wire up the calculator functionality so that entering a bill amount and selecting a tip percentage calculates and displays the tip amount and total.
acceptanceCriteria: When user enters a bill amount and selects a tip percentage, the tip amount updates immediately
When user enters a bill amount and selects a tip percentage, the total updates immediately
Selected tip percentage button is visually highlighted
User can change the tip percentage and see the results update
User can change the bill amount and see the results update
All currency values display with exactly 2 decimal places

tasks.title: Build Settings Screen UI
tasks.description: Implement the visual layout of the settings screen including header with back button, default tip percentage selector, and rounding toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen displays 'Settings' as the header
User sees a back button in the top-left corner
User sees a 'Default Tip Percentage' section with six percentage buttons
User sees a 'Round to Nearest Dollar' toggle switch with description text
Settings are organized under section headers ('Defaults' and 'Calculation')

tasks.title: Implement settings persistence
tasks.description: Enable saving and loading of user preferences (default tip percentage and rounding preference) so they persist across app sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: When user changes the default tip percentage, it remains selected after closing and reopening the app
When user toggles rounding on/off, the preference remains after closing and reopening the app
Settings screen shows the current saved values when opened

tasks.title: Connect navigation between screens
tasks.description: Wire up the settings icon and back button to navigate between the calculator and settings screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the settings icon on the calculator screen navigates to the settings screen
Tapping the back button on the settings screen returns to the calculator screen
Navigation transitions are smooth and immediate

tasks.title: Apply saved settings to calculator
tasks.description: Make the calculator use the saved default tip percentage and apply rounding when enabled. The calculator should reflect user preferences from the settings screen.
acceptanceCriteria: When app launches, the default tip percentage from settings is pre-selected on the calculator
When rounding is enabled in settings, the total amount rounds to the nearest dollar
When rounding is disabled in settings, the total shows exact cents
After changing settings and returning to calculator, the new settings are immediately applied

tasks.title: Calculator screen layout and input
tasks.description: Build the main calculator screen with bill amount input field, tip percentage button grid, and results display area
acceptanceCriteria: User sees a clean calculator interface with 'Tip Calculator' header
User can tap into the bill amount field to enter a dollar amount
User sees six tip percentage buttons arranged in a 3x2 grid (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 22%, 25%)
User sees a results section showing tip amount and total
User sees a settings icon in the top-right corner

tasks.title: Tip calculation and display
tasks.description: Calculate tip and total when user enters bill amount and selects tip percentage, updating the results display in real-time
acceptanceCriteria: User sees the selected tip percentage button highlighted
User can tap any tip percentage button to select it
User sees the tip amount update immediately when changing bill amount or tip percentage
User sees the total amount (bill + tip) update immediately
User sees amounts formatted as currency with dollar sign and two decimal places

tasks.title: Settings screen layout
tasks.description: Build the settings screen with back navigation, default tip percentage selector, and rounding toggle
acceptanceCriteria: User sees a 'Settings' header with a back button
User sees a 'Default Tip Percentage' section with six tip buttons
User sees the current default tip percentage highlighted
User sees a 'Round to Nearest Dollar' toggle switch
User sees descriptive text explaining what each setting does

tasks.title: Navigation between screens
tasks.description: Enable navigation from calculator to settings and back
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap the settings icon to open the settings screen
User can tap the back button to return to the calculator screen
User sees smooth transitions between screens

tasks.title: Save and apply default tip preference
tasks.description: Save the user's default tip percentage selection and automatically apply it when opening the calculator
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap any tip percentage in settings to set it as default
User sees the selected default tip remain highlighted when navigating away and returning to settings
User sees their default tip percentage pre-selected when opening the calculator screen
User sees the default tip preference persist even after closing and reopening the app

tasks.title: Rounding toggle functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to toggle rounding on/off and apply rounding to the final total when enabled
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap the rounding toggle to turn it on or off
User sees the toggle switch visually change state when tapped
User sees the total rounded to the nearest whole dollar when rounding is enabled
User sees the exact calculated total (with cents) when rounding is disabled
User sees the tip amount remain unrounded (always shows exact cents)
User sees the rounding preference persist when closing and reopening the app

tasks.title: Preserve calculator state during navigation
tasks.description: Maintain the entered bill amount and calculation results when navigating to settings and back
acceptanceCriteria: User sees their entered bill amount unchanged after navigating to settings and returning
User sees the calculated tip and total amounts unchanged after returning from settings (unless settings changed)
User sees the selected tip percentage remain the same after returning from settings

tasks.title: Calculator Input & Display
tasks.description: Build the main calculator screen layout with bill amount input field, header with title and settings icon, and results display area.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees 'Tip Calculator' as the screen title
User can tap into the bill amount field to enter a number
User sees a settings icon in the top right corner
User sees placeholders for tip amount and total in the results area

tasks.title: Tip Percentage Selection
tasks.description: Implement the grid of tip percentage buttons (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 22%, 25%) with visual selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees six tip percentage buttons arranged in a grid
User can tap any tip button to select it
Selected tip button is visually highlighted with accent color
Only one tip percentage can be selected at a time

tasks.title: Tip Calculation & Results
tasks.description: Calculate tip amount and total based on bill amount and selected tip percentage, displaying results in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees the tip amount update when they enter a bill amount
User sees the tip amount update when they select a different tip percentage
User sees the total (bill + tip) update automatically
All amounts display as currency with two decimal places

tasks.title: Settings Screen Layout
tasks.description: Build the settings screen with back button, section headers, and container for settings options.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees 'Settings' as the screen title
User sees a back button to return to the calculator
User sees section headers for 'Defaults' and 'Calculation'
User sees setting items with labels and descriptions

tasks.title: Default Tip Preference
tasks.description: Implement the default tip percentage selector in settings with visual selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees six tip percentage options in the settings
User can tap any percentage to set it as default
Selected default percentage is visually highlighted
User sees 'Default Tip Percentage' label with description

tasks.title: Rounding Toggle
tasks.description: Implement the toggle switch for rounding total to nearest dollar with on/off states.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees a toggle switch for 'Round to Nearest Dollar'
User can tap the toggle to turn rounding on or off
Toggle visually shows on state (accent color) and off state (gray)
User sees descriptive text 'Round final total for easier payment'

tasks.title: Navigation Between Screens
tasks.description: Connect the calculator and settings screens with navigation that preserves the current bill amount.
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap the settings icon to open the settings screen
User can tap the back button to return to the calculator
Bill amount remains visible when returning from settings
Screen transitions are smooth

tasks.title: Settings Persistence
tasks.description: Save user's default tip percentage and rounding preference, and apply them when the app opens.
acceptanceCriteria: User's default tip percentage is remembered when they close and reopen the app
User's rounding preference is remembered across sessions
Calculator screen shows the saved default tip percentage as selected on first load
Rounding is automatically applied when turned on

tasks.title: Apply Rounding to Calculation
tasks.description: When rounding is enabled, round the final total to the nearest dollar and adjust the tip amount accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees rounded total when rounding is turned on
User sees exact total when rounding is turned off
Tip amount adjusts to show the difference when total is rounded
Rounding only affects the final total, not intermediate calculations
